annotations.title: Get an upload URL for a track or cover

description: Returns a short-lived signed upload URL for one file of a draft release: the audio of one track (kind track: lossless FLAC, WAV or AIFF, 16 or 24 bit, same formats and checks as the studio upload, large WAVs are fine) or the cover (kind cover: JPEG, PNG or WebP, square, at least 1400 px, at most 20 MB). Upload the file as the raw request body with HTTP PUT (POST works too), no Authorization header, e.g. curl --fail -T "song.wav" "<uploadUrl>". The URL works for one file within 60 minutes. Then call studio_upload_finish with the upload ID to attach it. Tracks count towards the person's storage; the answer says how many bytes fit. The URL is private, never show it publicly.

bytes.description: File size in bytes, to check early that it fits

filename.description: File name, e.g. "01 Intro.wav"; the track title is taken from it unless studio_upload_finish gets a title

kind.description: track (audio of one track) or cover (release cover image)

name: studio_upload_prepare
title: Get an upload URL for a track or cover
